PhoneScrolled.dc.html.title: List page, scrolled to the end

Wide.dc.html.title: List page on a wide window

PhoneSearch.dc.html.title: A settings page that gains a search bar

Drama.dc.html.title: Dramatic motion and graphics, press Play

n-main.text: At the top. One large title with its count line under it. The statistics are one row that scrolls sideways: the last tile is cut on purpose and fades, so the row reads as scrollable. Nothing else on the page scrolls sideways. Try: Tweaks, accent colour. Unbuilt: the fade on the tile row, the smaller title sizes.

n-scrolled.text: Scrolled to the end. The large title has folded into a 56 px bar that keeps the page name and count. The page has ONE scroller. After the last row comes a spacer as tall as the bottom bar plus the create button plus 16, so the last row is never under either. The create button sits above the bar, never over a row's switch. Unbuilt: the folded bar, the end spacer on every list.

n-sheet.text: A sheet. The page behind is dimmed and does not scroll. The sheet is at most 88% of the screen. Its title and its buttons stay put, only the middle scrolls, with a soft fade at the edge where more content waits. Buttons are always reachable. Unbuilt: pinned buttons on tall dialogs, the scroll lock behind.

n-editor.text: Long words. Names wrap to two lines and then end in three dots, with the full name one tap away. Identifiers break anywhere and never push the card wider. Chips wrap to a new line. Value columns shrink before labels do. The save bar is part of the page flow at the end and sticks above the bottom bar only while there are changes. Unbuilt: the wrapping rules on entity rows, the save bar.

n-wide.text: Wide window. The same page: the title bar sticks, the table header sticks under it, and a table wider than its card scrolls inside the card, never the page. Content is centred with a 1200 px limit so rows do not stretch across a very wide screen. Resize the board to see it reflow. Unbuilt: the width limit on list pages.

n-rules.text: Rules every page follows. 1: one scroller per page, no scroller inside a scroller on the same axis. 2: nothing wider than the screen from 320 px up. 3: the end of the page clears every fixed thing. 4: text wraps or ends in three dots with the full text reachable, it is never sliced. 5: a sideways row shows that it scrolls. 6: sheets and dialogs keep their buttons on screen. 7: every target is 48 px or taller.

n-search.text: Search where it was missing. Any page with more than eight rows, tiles or options gets a search bar under its title, with the pattern builder button beside it. It also looks inside the pages it lists and says where the match is. Filter sheets get one too (see the sheet board). Hidden rows are counted, and clearing the search brings every one back. Unbuilt: all of it on the System and Settings tile pages and in filter sheets.

n-drama.text: Press Play, then press each button. Five moments with pictures: arriving, an update finished, something failed, deleted, nothing here yet. Bigger than canvas 34: pictures draw themselves, rays and rings leave, rows fall. Each plays once. Try Tweaks: motion off shows the end state at once. Unbuilt: the pictures, the rays, the falling row.

n-pills.text: Press Play and move the pointer. Floating pills replace the crowded toolbar row: page tools in one pill, selection actions in a second pill that appears only while rows are selected, and the create button as its own large pill. On a desktop a pill item widens to show its name on hover or keyboard focus, and Filter opens its menu on hover. On a phone the same pills open with a tap and sit above the bottom bar. Unbuilt: all of it.

n-keep.text: Nothing is removed. Every tool, filter, column, menu entry and setting that exists today stays reachable in the same number of presses or fewer. Tools that leave a toolbar row move into a pill or its More tools menu. Whoever builds a page lists every control on the page before and after, and a control missing afterwards fails the job.
